svg.title: omnitrix at work
svg.desc: Claude splits "add rate limiting to the public API" into six tasks. Gemini reads two weeks of logs, Codex writes the middleware, DeepSeek reviews it, Kimi is rate limited so the tests move to GLM, Groq drafts the changelog and a local Ollama model checks secrets. Claude then reviews the results.
